# /studio — Motion Studio director

Usage: `/studio run`, `/studio run <project>/<job> …`, or `/studio status`.

Read `.agents/skills/studio/SKILL.md` and follow it exactly for the subcommand typed after `/studio`. You are GitHub Copilot: your `<actor>` is `copilot-agent`.

Never run `approve`, `render`, `sequence` or `sequence-preview`, and never start the UI server. A person approves and renders in the UI.
